lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Explicit model: preparing the night before

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice preparing the night before. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner picks one real thing that happens most mornings, such as getting to a lesson, an activity, or a shared family errand on time, and writes a short list of everything they would otherwise have to find, decide, or do in the morning.
materials: learner-local: paper or a notes app
learner-local: the specific items the learner needs for their chosen morning responsibility

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe what was different about the next morning because of your night-before checklist, and say whether you will keep using it.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Checklist specificity: At least three specific, concrete items or decisions are listed and correctly marked as night-before-able or not. | Follow-through and comparison: Reflection names at least one specific difference the checklist made. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner build a second night-before checklist for a different weekly responsibility and compare which of the two responsibilities benefited more from advance preparation, and why.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice preparing the night before. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.elapsedWindow: Up to seven days; use only the check-ins explicitly named in the task
duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

resources.title: preparing the night before worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner picks one real thing that happens most mornings, such as getting to a lesson, an activity, or a shared family errand on time, and writes a short list of everything they would otherwise have to find, decide, or do in the morning.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact preparing the night before decision or action.
Model move 2: Pick one real morning responsibility that happens at least twice a week.
Model move 3: List every item, decision, or step you normally handle in the morning for this responsibility.

Model check: Checklist specificity: At least three specific, concrete items or decisions are listed and correctly marked as night-before-able or not. | Follow-through and comparison: Reflection names at least one specific difference the checklist made.

resources.title: preparing the night before action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for preparing the night before.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: preparing the night before coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner picks one real thing that happens most mornings, such as getting to a lesson, an activity, or a shared family errand on time, and writes a short list of everything they would otherwise have to find, decide, or do in the morning.
Coach direction: Pick one real morning responsibility that happens at least twice a week.
Learner prompt: Name the responsibility and one time in the last week it was rushed or almost late.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: preparing the night before complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: List every item, decision, or step you normally handle in the morning for this responsibility.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I listed at least three specific items or decisions, not a vague single line like 'get ready.'
Response 2 (t2-p2): I marked which of those items could realistically be set out or decided the night before.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: preparing the night before minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe what was different about the next morning because of your night-before checklist, and say whether you will keep using it.

Success checks: Checklist specificity: At least three specific, concrete items or decisions are listed and correctly marked as night-before-able or not. | Follow-through and comparison: Reflection names at least one specific difference the checklist made.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: preparing the night before supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional preparing the night before condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Checklist specificity: At least three specific, concrete items or decisions are listed and correctly marked as night-before-able or not. | Follow-through and comparison: Reflection names at least one specific difference the checklist made..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: preparing the night before — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the preparing the night before task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Describe what was different about the next morning because of your night-before checklist, and say whether you will keep using it.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Checklist specificity: At least three specific, concrete items or decisions are listed and correctly marked as night-before-able or not. | Follow-through and comparison: Reflection names at least one specific difference the checklist made.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u05-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
